# Automobile (`automobile`)

<!-- generated by scripts/build_techtree.py from techtree/core/navigation.yaml — do not edit -->

- Category: Navigation, transport & exploration (`navigation`)
- Deps: helped by internal_combustion_engine, petroleum_refining, rubber_vulcanisation, gears_gear_trains, ball_bearings, paved_roads_macadam
- Core idea: In an early petrol car a light, fast-running engine on liquid fuel drives the rear wheels through a clutch, a gearbox (the engine has a narrow speed range) and a differential that lets the outer wheel turn faster on curves; steering by pivoting the front wheels on separate kingpins (Ackermann geometry), pneumatic tyres and good brakes. Mass production on assembly lines made it cheap (Model T introduced in 1908, moving assembly line in 1913).
- Pitfalls:
  - A single fixed axle with both wheels locked together; it scrubs and tips in corners
  - Forgetting the gearbox and clutch; the engine cannot start under load
  - Exhaust fumes in closed spaces (carbon monoxide)
- History: europe: 1769 – Cugnot's steam carriage; 1886 Benz Patent-Motorwagen; 1886 Daimler and Maybach's motor carriage; americas: 1908 – Ford Model T; 1913 moving assembly line
- Read:
  - James J. Flink, The Automobile Age (1988)
